title: Bernoulli polynomials series via analytic summability of functions
summary: Analytic summability of real and complex functions was introduced in 2016. In the topic, the Bernoulli numbers and polynomials were used for defining analytic summand of a given function with a power series on an open domain $D$. In this paper, we study derivatives and integrals of the analytic summand functions and show that the derivatives are the same Bernoulli polynomials series $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}c_nB_n(z)$ up to a unit forward shift.
